key_idea: Keep a running total: each message adds one unread to the other n-1 people and clears the sender's unread count, which equals the number of messages since the sender's last one.
sketch: Store the index of each person's last message in a map (n up to 1e9, but only m<=1000 senders appear). On message i by s, total += (n-1) - (i-1-last[s]) with last[s]=0 if s never sent; then last[s]=i. O(m log m). Use 64-bit: total can reach about 1e12.
